description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Sett''' empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 50 '''bonus''' range and deal '''bonus''' physical damage, capped at 400 '''total''' damage of each attack against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description.text: Active: Sett empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to gain  50 bonus range and deal bonus physical damage, capped at 400 total damage of each attack against monsters.

description2.raw: For 1.5 seconds, '''Sett''' also gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 30% '''bonus''' movement speed while facing [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] within 2000 units.
description2.text: For 1.5 seconds, Sett also gains  30% bonus movement speed while facing visible enemy champions within 2000 units.

description3.raw: ''Knuckle Down [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Sett's''' basic attack timer. The empowered attacks are guaranteed to be a Left Punch followed by a Right Punch, resetting '''Sett's''' current [[File:Sett Pit Grit.png|20xpx|border|link=Sett#Pit Grit|An icon for Sett's ability Pit Grit]] [[Sett#Pit Grit|Pit Grit]] state (if applicable) and ignoring the usual time-out period for a follow-up Right Punch.''
description3.text: Knuckle Down resets Sett's basic attack timer. The empowered attacks are guaranteed to be a Left Punch followed by a Right Punch, resetting Sett's current Pit Grit state (if applicable) and ignoring the usual time-out period for a follow-up Right Punch.

leveling.raw:
'''Bonus Physical Damage:'''
10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 (+ 1% (+ 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3% per 100 AD) of target's '''maximum''' health)
'''Total Bonus Physical Damage:'''
20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 (+ 2% (+ 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6% per 100 AD) of target's '''maximum''' health)
leveling.text: Bonus Physical Damage:10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 (+ 1% (+ 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3% per 100 AD) of target's maximum health)Total Bonus Physical Damage:20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 (+ 2% (+ 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6% per 100 AD) of target's maximum health)

notes.raw: * The bonus movement speed buff is named ''Looking For a Fight''. * ''Knuckle Down'' can be [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]], [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] or missed while '''Sett''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]].
notes.text:
The bonus movement speed buff is named Looking For a Fight.
Knuckle Down can be dodged, blocked or missed while Sett is blinded.
